svg.text: Remaining manuscript sections excluded: cross-study comparison degrades extraction.
no reasoning · inference limited to what the text states · every value paired with its evidence span
absent information recorded as “unknown” · sample, replicate and fraction counts never defaulted to one
schema conformity and evidence presence; unknowns re-queried
populated field missing supporting evidence returned to its agent for repair
five-tier matcher, first accepted tier retained
original value retained alongside ontology ID, preferred label and matching tier; ambiguous mappings flagged
checks flag values for review rather than establish error; flagged values retained with machine-readable diagnostics
value · evidence span · ontology ID and preferred label · matching tier · QC flags · raw and normalised JSON
linked to the deposited raw files at project level
Each arm adds one component of a and retains
every component of the arm before it.
S0 is a separate baseline architecture rather
than a reduced form of the agent pipeline.
The ablation uses manuscript text alone; PRIDE
descriptors are excluded from every arm.
Every arm is scored against the SDRF gold
standard by weighted F1, Lin IC and matching
